text:
maria_infra: heads up @here — started the kernel 6.4 rolling upgrade in us-west1 this morning. after the first batch of racks (rack-12/rack-13) we’re seeing intermittent gpu process evictions w/o clear kernel oops. some jobs just drop sockets and nccl handshakes start failing.

sam_oncall: seeing the same on p4-8s. symptoms: containers lose nvpeer/nvlink, processes visible as Z or SIGPIPE in logs, then k8s evicts pods with OOM-ish messages even though mem/cpu look fine.

lee_runtime: can you paste the node dmesg + nvidia logs? curious if it’s the driver probe or a later teardown.

maria_infra: paste:```
[ 1234.567890] nvidia: probe deferred for minor 0 (err -16)
[ 1234.568012] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 162, pid=6723, Host engine exception on channel 0x0b
[ 1234.568900] nv_peer: nvlink: link state change, reset
[ 1235.001200] kubelet: killing container "trainer" pod "ml-job-xx" due to process exit code 141
```

ashley_sre: weird that probe deferred shows up during normal workload. did the kernel module load sequence change? which dkms package did we ship in the AMIs?

maria_infra: AMI uses nvidia-driver 535.86 + cuda 12.2 built against our 6.4-rc kernel config. we validated on a single canary host but not under sustained multi-job nccl traffic.

ops_cost: tagging — if we end up reprovisioning fleet or rolling back, estimate ~120 reserved GPU-hours to reprovision eu-west2 mirror and ~300 spot-hours to catch up. likely $3.5k/day at current runrate if we need capacity doubling.

lee_runtime: temporary mitigation — can we force driver fallback to 535.54 (previous build) via module alias on the nodes? or do we need full host reprovision?

maria_infra: tried `modprobe -r nvidia && modprobe nvidia` on one node, module loads but shortly after nvlink flaps and containers fail. fallback driver didn't help; suspect kernel-side change in pci/iommu ordering.

sam_oncall: rolling rollback plan: pause upgrade in us-west1, add node taint to prevent new workloads hitting suspect racks, and set autoscaler to drain old pods to eu-west for high priority ML jobs. command I ran: `kubectl cordon rack-12-node-04` then `kubectl drain rack-12-node-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`. :warning:

maria_infra: good call. pausing rollout. also putting a canary pool with kernel pinned to 5.15 for one rack for A/B compare.

nccle_team: from NCCL side we see repeated `ncclSystemError` and `NCCL_UNSUPPORTED_OP` during handshakes when NVLINK drops. logs show frequent `NCCL WARN` with `transport` fallback to TCP. perf impact: 70% latency increase for all-reduce on 8x devices.

ashley_sre: question for infra — any regional capacity constraints if we shift more jobs to eu-west or us-central? we have spare free GPUs in us-central but they are tagged restricted (compliance).

ops_cost: eu-west has ~40% free capacity but cold; bringing it up will incur provisioning lead time (1–2 hours) and burst-on-demand cost ~2.8x. us-central restricted capacity could be used if team signs off on temporary exemption — quick approvals would save ~$2k/day vs eu-west burst.

lee_runtime: re: repro steps — can someone capture `lspci -vvv`, `dmesg` and `modinfo nvidia` from a failing host and a healthy 5.15 host? I want to diff pci feature flags and driver probe parameters.

maria_infra: collecting now, will paste in a short thread. also adding an automated smoke job that runs an 8-GPU NCCL all-reduce loop after kernel install in the canary pipeline. if that passes we continue, if not we rollback.

sam_oncall: creating incident channel and paging oncall leads. if we fail to stabilize us-west1 by EOD we should start preemptive reservations for dedicated capacity to avoid customer impact. :rotating_light:

maria_infra: thanks — paused rollout, cordoned racks, canary pool pinned to 5.15, smoke test added, ops_cost engaged. will update with diffs in 15m.

deploy_bot: deployment 2024-06-27-06:15:12: kernel-upgrade-us-west1 batch-01 PAUSED by maria_infra

sam_oncall: small note — set `NVreg_RestrictProfilingToAdmin=1` off? I saw a kernel option that changes driver init timing. worth trying on one canary before wider changes.

maria_infra: noted. trying that flag on rack-12-node-07 now and will report.

lee_runtime: thanks everyone. main ask: grab the failing host artifacts and open a bisect job if we can't isolate quickly. prefer not to reprovision entire racks until we have a root cause.

nccle_team: will attach NCCL logs to the incident and provide a quick pack of failing handshake traces.

ashley_sre: adding retrospective action items — preflight stress test for kernel upgrades, automated nvlink health probe, and cost playbook for cross-region failover.

maria_infra: update — rack-12-node-07 with `NVreg_RestrictProfilingToAdmin=0` shows fewer probe defers, but still occasional nvlink resets. smoke job failed after ~18 minutes. continuing diagnostics.

sam_oncall: copy. ping if you need extra hands to run bisection or snapshot AMIs.

maria_infra: will do — thanks all.
